Dimitri Papadopoulos  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 123 4567 | dimitri.papadopoulos@example.com  

A junior QA/Test Engineer with a passion for ensuring seamless gaming experiences through rigorous testing and automation. Over the past year, I’ve transitioned from manual testing to contributing to scalable test frameworks, focusing on reducing regression defects and streamlining CI/CD workflows. My work has centered on bridging gaps between development and quality assurance, with a strong emphasis on measurable outcomes and process optimization.  

**Projects**  
*PixelForge Studios – QA Intern (6 months)*  
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify and document critical bugs in mobile game builds, improving communication between developers and testers. Tracked bug resolution rates using Jira, contributing to a 85%+ closure rate for reported issues.  

*ArcadeGame Co. – QA Tester (6 months)*  
Focused on regression testing for multiplayer game features, creating Python scripts to automate repetitive validation tasks. Analyzed test results to prioritize high-impact bug fixes, ensuring stability across platform updates.  

*IndieGameDev Studio – Test Engineer (1 year)*  
Designed and executed automated test suites using Playwright, reducing manual testing hours by 30%. Optimized GitLab CI pipelines to cut deployment feedback loops from 4 hours to 15 minutes, enabling faster iterations.  

**Professional Experience**  
*QA Tester | ArcadeGame Co.*  
Developed Python-based test scripts for core game mechanics, reducing regression testing time by 25%. Partnered with developers to create testable code structures, improving defect detection rates during early-stage sprints.  

*Test Engineer | IndieGameDev Studio*  
Led the automation of 30+ test cases for mobile game modules, achieving a 40% reduction in critical regression defects. Integrated GitLab CI with test environments to enable parallel execution, shortening test cycles by 20%.  

*QA Intern | PixelForge Studios*  
Supported the QA team in manual testing of mobile games, identifying usability issues in UI/UX workflows. Documented over 200 bugs, with 85% resolved within two sprints.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Athens | Graduated 2022  

**Technical Skills**  
- **API Testing**: Validated RESTful endpoints for game backend systems, ensuring data integrity during player interactions.  
- **GitLab CI**: Configured pipeline stages for automated testing, reducing deployment delays by 50% in CI/CD workflows.  
- **Python**: Scripted test automation frameworks for repetitive validation tasks, improving test coverage by 25%.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Automated browser-based game testing, achieving 95% script reusability across platform updates.  
- **Test Automation**: Designed modular test suites for mobile and web game features, reducing manual test effort by 35%.  
- **Integration Testing**: Participated in end-to-end testing of game modules, ensuring compatibility between frontend and backend systems.  
- **JavaScript**: Implemented basic test scripts for dynamic UI elements, supporting cross-browser compatibility checks.  
- **Web Accessibility (WCAG)**: Conducted basic audits for game UI elements, ensuring compliance with level AA standards.  

**Languages**  
English (native), Hebrew (fluent)
